note: Singlets1: single cells (first doublet/aggregate exclusion) — events on the linear SSC-H ≈ SSC-A diagonal; off-diagonal events above the diagonal (SSC-A inflated relative to SSC-H, indicating coincident events / aggregates) and the SSC-A saturation edge at the top are excluded.
tips: First singlet discrimination on the SSC-H × SSC-A diagonal — singlet events fall on the linear diagonal; doublets/aggregates deviate because area scales faster than height when two events are coincident.
